images.title: Three story types, three moves
images.purpose: Recap the three kinds of problem in this practice and the move that solves each one.
images.composition: Three equal cards in a row across the middle, each with one small icon above one short line, even gaps and wide margins.
exact_structure: Card 1, teal #0072B2 outline: icon of three small stacks of equal blocks lined up level. Text: Divisible by all: use the LCM.
Card 2, amber #E69F00 outline: icon of two dots on a track, a big dot behind a small dot with a short reddish purple #CC79A7 gap bar between them. Text: Chase: head start ÷ gain.
Card 3, green #009E73 outline: icon of two fraction bars cut into the same number of equal cells. Text: Fractions: LCM of denominators.
No numbers anywhere in the image.
labels: Divisible by all: use the LCM
rejection: any number, answer or worked problem shown

images.takeaway: Each problem type has one key move: the LCM for divisibility and fractions, the gain per leap for a chase.
images.description: Three cards: Divisible by all, use the LCM; Chase, head start ÷ gain; Fractions, LCM of denominators.
images.context: Shown beside the practice items on more problems with HCF and LCM.
images.teaching_notes: Before each item, name which card it matches.

image_decisions.why: A three card recap reminds students of each method without giving away the practice answers.
